name: tia_delete_hardware
description: Delete a device or one device item (module/submodule). Without confirm=true only a preview of what would be deleted is returned.

device_name.description: Exact device (station) name as listed by tia_list_devices, e.g. 'PLC_1' or 'ACS480_1'.

item_path.description: Item to delete; omit to delete the whole device.

confirm.description: Must be true to delete (default: false = preview).
